text:
## Key summary

- Buying or renewing ride passes accounted for 41% of support tickets last quarter; the pass button is currently two menu levels deep. [t4, t5]
- Ride passes will move to the first screen, and the referral program will stay out of this release. [t13, t14, t15]
- Leo will measure and share unlock API latency; Priya will prepare mockups by next Thursday. [t10, t12]
- Whether to retain the old map view for older phones remains open for discussion next week. [t15, t16]

## Agenda

- Review the Arbor Bikes app’s new first screen and whether ride passes should move there. [t1, t2, t6]

## Decisions

- Move ride passes to the first screen. [t13, t14, t15]
- Exclude the referral program from this release. [t13, t14, t15]

## Tasks

- [ ] Measure unlock API latency and share the results (Leo / deadline to be set after checking the sprint). [t10, t11]
- [ ] Prepare mockups (Priya / next Thursday). [t12]

## Open issues

- Whether to keep the old map view for older phones; revisit next week. [t15, t16]

## Review needed

- Leo reported current median bike-unlocking time as 2.3 seconds and said users tap twice when it is slow; proper measurement is pending. [t8, t9, t10]
